settings.heading: Start with what your skin tells you.

Clinically trained.
Expertly curated.
settings.body: Emmalee Fitton is a SkinCeuticals European Master Physician with over a decade on the clinic floor and 2,000+ personal skin consultations. Every product she recommends is one she has personally tested, used clinically, and stands behind.

settings.question: How much does the consultation cost?
settings.answer: The consultation is £20, but this is fully redeemable against your first purchase — so it effectively costs nothing if you go on to buy a product. Most clients do.

settings.question: Is it in-person or online?
settings.answer: We offer both. A 45-minute face-to-face appointment at our clinic, or a 20-minute phone consultation from wherever you are. You choose at the point of booking.

settings.question: What will I receive after my consultation?
settings.answer: A personalised AM/PM skincare routine, a 90-day skin plan, and specific product recommendations tailored to your skin type and concerns. You'll leave knowing exactly what to buy and why.

settings.question: Do I have to buy from TheSkinBay?
settings.answer: There's no obligation at all. However, every product Emmalee recommends is available in store, and your £20 fee is fully redeemable — so there's a real incentive to shop with us.

settings.question: How do I book?
settings.answer: Click the booking button on this page to choose your slot. We offer morning, afternoon and evening appointments. If you need help, email us at info@theskinbay.co.uk and we'll get you sorted.
